# Types

C's scalar types under their C names, sized for the current target.

<h2 id="c-bool"><code>c_bool</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_bool = bool8
```

C's `_Bool`, which occupies one byte and holds zero or one.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L75)

<h2 id="c-char"><code>c_char</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_char = int8
```

C's plain `char`, whose signedness the standard leaves to the implementation.
Signed on every currently supported target. A binding whose meaning depends on the sign should name [`c_schar`](/docs/api/c/types#c-schar) or
[`c_uchar`](/docs/api/c/types#c-uchar) instead of relying on this.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L30)

<h2 id="c-double"><code>c_double</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_double = float64
```

C's `double`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L70)

<h2 id="c-float"><code>c_float</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_float = float32
```

C's `float`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L65)

<h2 id="c-int"><code>c_int</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_int = int32
```

C's `int`, which is 32 bits on every currently supported target.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L45)

<h2 id="c-long"><code>c_long</code></h2>

```rux
// Windows
pub type c_long = int32

// Linux · macOS · FreeBSD
pub type c_long = int64
```

C's `long`, 32 bits under this target's LLP64 data model.

| Overload                  | Summary                                                   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub type c_long = int32` | C's `long`, 32 bits under this target's LLP64 data model. |
| `pub type c_long = int64` | C's `long`, 64 bits under this target's LP64 data model.  |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L85)

<h2 id="c-longlong"><code>c_longlong</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_longlong = int64
```

C's `long long`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L55)

<h2 id="c-schar"><code>c_schar</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_schar = int8
```

C's `signed char`: the smallest addressable signed integer.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L18)

<h2 id="c-short"><code>c_short</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_short = int16
```

C's `short`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L35)

<h2 id="c-uchar"><code>c_uchar</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_uchar = uint8
```

C's `unsigned char`, which is also the type a byte of arbitrary storage is read through.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L23)

<h2 id="c-uint"><code>c_uint</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_uint = uint32
```

C's `unsigned int`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L50)

<h2 id="c-ulong"><code>c_ulong</code></h2>

```rux
// Windows
pub type c_ulong = uint32

// Linux · macOS · FreeBSD
pub type c_ulong = uint64
```

C's `unsigned long`, 32 bits under this target's LLP64 data model.

| Overload                    | Summary                                                            |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `pub type c_ulong = uint32` | C's `unsigned long`, 32 bits under this target's LLP64 data model. |
| `pub type c_ulong = uint64` | C's `unsigned long`, 64 bits under this target's LP64 data model.  |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L90)

<h2 id="c-ulonglong"><code>c_ulonglong</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_ulonglong = uint64
```

C's `unsigned long long`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L60)

<h2 id="c-ushort"><code>c_ushort</code></h2>

```rux
pub type c_ushort = uint16
```

C's `unsigned short`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L40)

<h2 id="intptr-t"><code>intptr_t</code></h2>

```rux
pub type intptr_t = int
```

C's `intptr_t`: a signed integer wide enough to hold any pointer.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L137)

<h2 id="ptrdiff-t"><code>ptrdiff_t</code></h2>

```rux
pub type ptrdiff_t = int
```

C's `ptrdiff_t`: the signed difference between two pointers into one object.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L132)

<h2 id="size-t"><code>size_t</code></h2>

```rux
pub type size_t = uint
```

C's `size_t`: the type of a size, a count of bytes, and the result of `sizeof`.
Pointer-sized and unsigned on every supported target.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L120)

<h2 id="ssize-t"><code>ssize_t</code></h2>

```rux
pub type ssize_t = int
```

POSIX's `ssize_t`: a size that can also report `-1` for failure.
Declared on every target for the sake of bindings that share a signature, though Windows has no such type of its
own and its C runtime spells the same thing `int` or `__int64` depending on the call.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L127)

<h2 id="uintptr-t"><code>uintptr_t</code></h2>

```rux
pub type uintptr_t = uint
```

C's `uintptr_t`: an unsigned integer wide enough to hold any pointer.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L142)

<h2 id="wchar-t"><code>wchar_t</code></h2>

```rux
// Windows
pub type wchar_t = char16

// Linux · macOS · FreeBSD
pub type wchar_t = char32
```

C's `wchar_t`, a 16-bit UTF-16 code unit on Windows rather than a whole scalar value.

| Overload                    | Summary                                                                               |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub type wchar_t = char16` | C's `wchar_t`, a 16-bit UTF-16 code unit on Windows rather than a whole scalar value. |
| `pub type wchar_t = char32` | C's `wchar_t`, a 32-bit Unicode scalar value on this target.                          |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/C/Src/Types.rux#L95)
